column1: # The finished features, and the field of a content pack that switches each one on.
# id <tab> module <tab> proof <tab> name <tab> off (only for a feature that no played stage has)
# proof: section.field, or section[].field for any entry of a list section; add =value when the value matters.
# A feature is on in a stage when the stage's pack (played.tsv) holds the proof. Absent, false, 0 and empty are off.
# A feature that is on in no stage is not finished. The ones marked off are the debt of today; a new feature gets its
# row, without the mark, in the change that adds it, and the mark goes in the change that switches a feature on.
